name: metabob-activity-api
description: Lightweight TypeScript server for Metabob activity system - replaces Python RPC API v2 endpoints

scripts.init-data: echo 'DEPRECATED: MiniBob instance creation removed (migration 052). Creates organization only.' && bun run sql/init-test-data.ts
scripts.preflight: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun test
scripts.clean:artifacts: find . -name '*.log' -o -name 'test-*' -o -name '*.tmp' | grep -v node_modules | xargs rm -f 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.version:check: node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); const tag = require('child_process').execSync('git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo v0.0.0').toString().trim().replace('v',''); if (tag !== pkg.version) { console.log('Version mismatch: package.json=' + pkg.version + ', latest tag=v' + tag); process.exit(1); }"
